name: Challenger (STS 61-A)
about: Challenger (STS 61-A) (1985-104A), a crewed vehicle (OV-099), launched 1985 Oct 30. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1985 Nov  1), held fixed
GCAT names the site (EAFB RW17); its coordinates are written from memory
